---
name: Feature, font or artwork proposal
about: Discuss an addition and its source before preparing a large change
---
## Intended result

Who would use this and what would they be able to do? Identify the affected platform and include a small example.

## Implementation or asset source

For a code proposal, describe the affected feature or file format. For a font, artwork or fixture, identify the author or foundry, upstream source, version, license text, and the permission covering redistribution.
